title: system-as-prompt
description: The typed envelope carrying the MINIMAL RECURRING SYSTEM (the vehicle) that conducts to a given goal. The third envelope of the ooda-loop typed set: handoff-as-prompt says WHERE I AM (the goal), dod-as-prompt says WHEN TO STOP (the measurable DoD), and this says WHAT TO DO EACH ROUND (the recurring minimal step). Without it a driver improvises its action every round — the exact failure the law names: 'isso nao e uma meta, e simplesmente uma sequencia de acoes'. NO execution engine, NO convergence gate, NO verifier: driving is gap-loop/quiesce's job and the independent audit is theirs (verifier != generator, Huang et al. 2310.01798). This envelope only DERIVES and WIRES. Law: rules/derive-system-from-goal.md ([C22], soul-name Hodos, ho-dos = 'a method, system; a way' — the root of methodos = meta + hodos).

for_goal.description: the {{goal}} this system conducts to — MUST equal the driving handoff-as-prompt.params.goal AND the dod-as-prompt.params.for_goal (L8 traceability). A system divorced from its goal is a SpecError: it is a sequence of actions, not a vehicle.

context_lock.description: SAME context_lock as the sibling dod-as-prompt (sourced from the handoff-as-prompt: context<-context, purpose<-objectives.originating, stakeholder/targets<-scope+motivations). A system is only minimal RELATIVE to a context — 'so easy it is impossible to say no' has no meaning without knowing whose day it fits in.

minimal_system.description: THE VEHICLE. An implementation-intention (if-then) pair plus the justification that it is genuinely minimal. Anchors: Gollwitzer & Sheeran 2006 (implementation intentions, d=0.65, 94 tests / 2024 update 642 tests) for the trigger->action form; BJ Fogg Tiny Habits + Lally 2010 for the minimality bar.

trigger.description: P2 — the IF half of the implementation intention: the concrete recurring cue that fires the action (an event, a phase boundary, a session start, a commit). NOT a time-of-day wish ('when I feel like it' is not a trigger). Deterministic where possible.

action.description: P1 — the THEN half: the single minimal recurring step. Must be small enough that refusing it is practically impossible ({ts:511} 'tao facil que seja praticamente impossivel voce dizer nao'). One step, not a plan. If it needs sub-steps it is not yet minimal.

why_minimal.description: P1's honesty gate — WHY is this impossible to say no to? An unfalsifiable 'it is small' is theater (anti-theater R2). State the cost (time/tokens/attention) and why that cost cannot reasonably be refused in this context_lock.

cadence.description: P2 — consistency over intensity ({ts:518} 'melhor 10 minutos de caminhada por dia do que 3 horas'). The recurrence, expressed relative to the trigger (per-round / per-session / per-commit / per-PR). NOT a wall-clock schedule: no cadence substrate exists (see $comment).

adherence_signal.description: P3, Metron-ADMISSIBLE form. NOT a raw activity count — '#runs' / '#steps-executed' are on the agentic-observability-protocol (Metron) §5 VANITY BLACKLIST, and 'count how many times we ran the playbook' lands squarely on it. The admissible signal is the two-part predicate: 'does the mechanism still FIRE — AND does firing still MOVE the goal?' — decision-gated (does-not-fire => rebuild the vehicle) + outcome-anchored (the system's whole purpose IS the goal). Precedent: Metron SLI S6 drift-signal. The system is the MANAGED object; the goal's number is the INFORMING signal (Metron §1: 'Measure-to-Inform, Manage-to-Outcome').

revision_trigger.description: REV — the guard the source video LACKS, and the answer to the Nat Eliason counter-criticism ('systems without goals is a path to mediocrity'). The condition under which the SYSTEM is falsified rather than the driver blamed: canonically 'adherence high AND goal-movement absent after N rounds => the vehicle is wrong => re-derive'. Without this, P3 ('track the system, not the goal's number') degenerates into driving a broken vehicle diligently.

consumed_as.description: OPTIONAL — the wiring note. minimal_system.ACTION (the string; minimal_system itself is an object) reaches the driver via its POSITIONAL "<instructions>" argument ('extra free-text appended to the goal' — gap-loop SKILL.md:194), NOT via a new flag: no flag for 'the recurring action' exists, and inventing one would be an interface fabrication (anti-theater R4). The sibling envelopes keep their existing typed flags: handoff -> --state-source=handoff:<file>, dod -> --condition=<termination_predicate>.

$comment: Idempotency (validate_envelope.py --digest): the SYSTEM DEFINITION (context_lock + minimal_system.trigger/action/cadence + adherence_signal + revision_trigger) is canonicalized (why_minimal prose + consumed_as stripped) so the same {goal,context} yields the same system-shape digest across runs. Exit: 0 valid, 2 unreadable, 3 SpecError. SpecError cases (what this validator ACTUALLY enforces): absent required key; a non-object where an object is required (params, context_lock, minimal_system); empty for_goal; empty minimal_system.trigger/action/why_minimal/cadence; empty adherence_signal; empty revision_trigger; wrong identity const (jsonrpc, method, data.type, data.layer, data.engine). NOT MACHINE-ENFORCED (design intent — stated plainly so it is never mistaken for a gate): (a) for_goal equality with the sibling handoff/dod envelopes (L8 traceability — a system for a different goal is a detour, not a vehicle) is structurally OUT OF REACH of a single-envelope validator, which never sees its siblings; it is the deriving agent's obligation and a reviewer check where all three envelopes meet (ooda-loop DECIDE) — it is NOT implemented there today either, so do not read it as a gate. (b) minimal_system.action being ONE step rather than an enumerated plan (P1) is carried by the deriving agent's why_minimal honesty gate, not by a string heuristic — a regex for '1. 2. 3.' would false-positive on valid prose, and adding a brittle detector to LOOK strict is the ceremony over-engineering-circuit-breaker forbids. HONEST LIMITATION — NO CADENCE SUBSTRATE EXISTS: 'cadence' is a predicate STRING consumed by the driver per-round, NOT a scheduled job and NOT a longitudinal adherence ledger. The only launchd on this machine is machine-health; bin/dogfood-mark + dogfood-tally are a maturity CYCLE-COUNTER (they collapse time via max_by, cycle_id is opaque-not-a-time-bucket, the subject is a TOOL not a goal, and there is no 'should' denominator) — reusable as a FORMAT (append-only JSONL under ~/.claude/audit/, POSIX Bash 3.2 + jq, mkdir-lock atomic append, writer/reader SRP split) if longitudinal tracking is ever built, but it is NOT one today. Do not read 'cadence' as a promise of scheduling.
